pageDescription: Schedule assigned by HR. Please confirm your attendance, or decline with a reason.

errors.reasonTooShort: Please enter a reason (at least 3 characters).

errors.slotPassed: This appointment has already passed, so it can no longer be answered. Contact HR directly if something went wrong.
errors.noLongerValid: This appointment is no longer valid — you declined it earlier, or HR changed it.

loginRequired.message: Please log in to the Candidate Portal to view and confirm your interview schedule.

noSchedule: HR has not scheduled anything for you yet. You will be notified as soon as they do.

awaitingSection.title: {{jobTitle}} · {{roundLabel}}
awaitingSection.message: You declined this session{{declineReason}}. If you still wish to continue, contact HR directly to agree on another time.

scheduleItem.confirmedLocked: You have confirmed attendance. This decision is locked and cannot be changed.

prep.title: What to prepare
prep.item1: Bring your ID card and the 6-character interview code to enter at the office Kiosk.
prep.item2: Arrive about 10 minutes early so there is time to check your microphone and camera.
prep.item3: The interview code is single-use and expires 2 hours after it is issued.

practiceCard.title: Practice before the real thing
practiceCard.description: Each round includes one practice interview so you can get used to the AI — it does not affect your hiring result.

modal.declineReasonPlaceholder: e.g. I have an exam on Aug 20 and cannot attend.
modal.warning: Are you sure about your decision? After clicking, you will not be able to modify this choice.
modal.warningDecline: This declines this interview — the system does NOT arrange another slot for you. If you still want to take part, contact HR directly.
modal.declineReasonHint: This reason goes to HR. Say clearly if you no longer wish to continue.
modal.warningDeclineTest: You are declining this online test — the system will NOT reschedule it for you. If you still want to take part, contact HR directly.

prepTest.title: Preparing for the online test
prepTest.item1: Take the test online right on the Candidate Portal — no office visit and no interview code needed.
prepTest.item2: The test opens at the scheduled time and closes at the end time shown on your schedule. You can still join late, but the timer runs to the closing time, so you get less time.
prepTest.item3: You have one attempt; leaving the page mid-test submits it automatically — make sure your connection is stable.
